video_title: Kuminga BIG Help To Timberwolves? + SHOCKING NBA Awards Predictions

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga signs a two-year deal with the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Jonathan Kuminga to the Minnesota Timberwolves. I mean, this is a marriage, perhaps a temporary marriage of convenience.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Your guy, Jonathan Kuminga to the Minnesota Timberwolves. I mean, this is a marriage, perhaps a temporary marriage of convenience, but look man, say what you want to say, there is interest in Kuminga, there is interest in the Timberwolves. This is an interesting deal.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: It is an interesting deal, I will give you that. He is getting a one-year plus a player option, which is basically set up for, and like you said, the Timberwolves are in real need of a starter power forward. Kuminga is in need of a team where he has a big role that he can go back to the market next year and try to get the contract that he has wanted. He has wanted a starting role for a long time and that is what he is getting here from day one, and they needed it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves may need to trade Josh Green to clear roster space
quotes.excerpt: They are going to have to figure out a way probably to dump Josh Green

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: They are going to have to figure out a way probably to dump Josh Green to be able to get to the taxpayer mid-level and standard of the second apron.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Right, so they have only got about three and a half million right now, I think. So they have to do that and I guess they could, so Saturday is the day that they would have all. There is a couple of players who are looking at possibly being waived and stretched by Saturday. If you don't waive a player by Saturday, his contract can't be stretched.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' role and development with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: This frees Anthony Edwards up to play off the ball a lot, not to have to be the primary facilitator.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: They needed to get Anthony Edwards somebody who Anthony Edwards looked at as a potential long-term co-star. And this frees Anthony Edwards up to play off the ball a lot, not to have to be the primary facilitator. Anthony Edwards basically played out of position as a point guard all of last season.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Yeah, and he needs opportunity. Anthony Edwards played a significant role in recruiting Kuminga. From what I understand, Anthony Edwards was very excited by the Timberwolves' off-season, going to get Lamelo Ball, making this deal happen for Kuminga.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Benedict Mathurin signs a one-plus-one deal with the New Orleans Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: New Orleans' first significant move of the off-season, signing him to a one-plus-one.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I had another free agency situation get settled since we last spoke and that was Benedict Mathurin doing a deal to go to New Orleans. New Orleans' first significant move of the off-season, signing him to a one-plus-one. Now, this deal is not done. It's not going to be a sign-and-trade because again, it's a one-plus-one, you can't do that in a sign-and-trade.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: And he was in that trade for Zubac. I mean, he got shots and scored some points for the Clippers, but he was in that trade because of salary filler and because the Pacers were ready to move on from him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaedon Sharpe undergoes surgery for a torn meniscus
quotes.excerpt: The Trail Blazers just officially announced that Shaedon Sharpe tore his meniscus last week in a workout.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Trail Blazers just officially announced that Shaedon Sharpe tore his meniscus last week in a workout and had surgery this week and he will be re-evaluated in six months. Re-evaluated. So maybe not season-ending, but major season-impacting him.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The extension was in place before last season. But yeah, he put up some numbers and again, another guy, this is the same theme as Kuminga and as Mathurin, like what was he? He was the seventh overall pick in 2022, 23 years old.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA issues statement regarding criticism of CBA rules
quotes.excerpt: Regarding recent media reports discussing the impact of CBA rules on team bids for restricted free agents.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I'll just read it so that you can know, but they are basically defending the idea that restricted free agency is, you know, kills players. So here is the quote from the NBA league office, which they don't make quotes like this very often. Regarding recent media reports discussing the impact of CBA rules on team bids for restricted free agents. Of this year's 12 RFAs, two changed teams via sign-and-trade, the most since 2021; two signed offer sheets with new teams, tied for the most since 2018; and six agreed to multi-year deals with their prior teams. It is not unusual at this point in the offseason that a couple of negotiations remain ongoing.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I think this CBA does factor into the difficulty of those negotiations.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is the projected MVP for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: The projected MVP by ESPN's never wrong panel is Victor Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The projected MVP by ESPN's never wrong panel is Victor Wembanyama. Second place in our poll was Jokic, which is interesting because I think what the voters are saying here is they think that with what is going to be required of him this year that, and by the way, I was, he was my MVP at the first straw poll last year, I voted for him for MVP, I am pretty sure.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: And then two through four, you have Jokic at 31 points, Luka at 28 points, and Shai at 26 points. Which is basically saying there is a clear front runner and then three guys that we anticipate will be in the mix.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer projected as Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: Cameron Boozer was selected as the pick by the ESPN panel with 61 points.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Cameron Boozer was selected as the pick by the ESPN panel with 61 points, however we came to that term. Darryn Peterson was second at 56, Aj Dybantsa third at 54, so very tight.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: And Caleb Wilson fourth at 32, so yeah, that's as close to four co-favorites as you can get.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson's potential breakout season with the Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I think he's poised for a breakout. I think it's a great move for Cleveland.
quotes.quote: As I was talking to executives this week on doing our awards thing, I just had this guy throw in there. I didn't even ask about. He was like, by the way, I love this Peyton Watson move. I think he's poised for a breakout. I think it's a great move for Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Cleveland Cavaliers' investment in Peyton Watson
quotes.excerpt: These people that we're talking to, these are all lifetime, have been in the league 20 plus years.
quotes.quote: These people that we're talking to, these are all lifetime, have been in the league 20 plus years and seen so much and evaluated so many players. It's fascinating when you will talk about the same topic to two different people and two people are like, a lot of times they're sort of in the middle. But one guy going, oh man, I cannot believe the Cavs gave Watson $90 million based on one month.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's ongoing impact on the Akron community
quotes.excerpt: LeBron has done so many things for his hometown of Akron that has influenced kids.
quotes.quote: LeBron has done so many things for his hometown of Akron that has influenced kids. Even now, school just started, and because his I Promise school is now not brand new, it's easy to forget, it's still impacting so many kids every single day. I remember back in 2015, going to Cedar Point, which is a famous amusement park in Ohio, and LeBron made this announcement to like a thousand of his kids that he brought there and paid for them to go in and everything for the day. And he's like, I'm giving you all college scholarships. I made a deal with the University of Akron, and you guys are all going to get to go to college four years for free.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's new partnership with the PGA Tour in Akron
quotes.excerpt: LeBron and the PGA Tour made an agreement and an announcement this week.
quotes.quote: LeBron and the PGA Tour made an agreement and an announcement this week. First off, it's still jaw-dropping to me that LeBron is this into golf. LeBron has done so many things for his hometown of Akron that has influenced kids. He didn't sign with the Cavs this summer, but he's still doing things for his hometown. And yes, teaching underprivileged kids and giving them a place to call is a higher calling than making sure there's a local golf tournament. I understand that and I'm acknowledging that. But this is something he did to help Akron out when it was about to lose something all together.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential for a LeBron, Steph, and Windhorst golf trio
quotes.excerpt: If they get LeBron, Steph, and you, the three biggest names ever born in Akron.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If they get LeBron, Steph, and you, the three biggest names ever born in Akron, like this thing could be huge.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I'm sure that's exactly how they look at it.
